subject.title: Anthropic rejects when multiple tool_result are split across separate messages

question: Should this ClawHub issue be manually closed as resolved by the shipped OpenClaw runtime fix in v2026.4.24?
rationale: The central bug is demonstrably fixed, but ClawHub's cleanup profile only authorizes automatic implemented-on-main closure for implementation present in this target repository.
